description: The plot illustrates the relationship between cost and reliability score for different models, comparing individual and ensemble models. The x-axis is labeled "Cost" with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 10, and tick labels at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled "Reliability Score" with a linear scale, ranging from 30 to 90, and tick labels at intervals of 10. The plot features three lines: a blue line representing the 3-Model Ensemble, a red line representing the 2-Model Ensemble, and a yellow line representing GPT-4. The blue line starts at a reliability score of around 87 at a cost of 0 and decreases to around 84 at a cost of 10. The red line begins at a reliability score of around 90 at a cost of 0 and decreases to around 83 at a cost of 10. The yellow line starts at a reliability score of around 88 at a cost of 0, decreases to around 65 at a cost of 4, and further decreases to around 45 at a cost of 10.
